title: EccCmsSharedInfo as a proper Sequence struct rather than hand-rolled DER
description: The EccCmsSharedInfo structure (RFC 5753 §7.2) is represented as a Rust struct with #[derive(Sequence)] and proper ASN.1 field annotations, rather than hand-rolled DER. This means the DER encoding is verified by the der crate's type system. A future contributor might suggest replacing it with manual byte concatenation for 'simplicity' — this would introduce encoding bugs and remove the round-trip correctness guarantee.
close_reason: Confirmed: EccCmsSharedInfo in encrypt.rs (lines 55-67) is a typed struct with #[derive(Sequence)] from the der crate. Fields map directly to the RFC 5753 §7.2 ASN.1 definition with correct context-specific tags (entityUInfo [0] EXPLICIT OPTIONAL, suppPubInfo [2] EXPLICIT). DER encoding via .to_der() at line 455. No hand-rolled DER.
